dct_description_sm:
This repository contains input data, models and simulation results associated with the article:
"Simulating the impact of climate change on energy consumption and yield in Canadian greenhouse horticulture" 
Published in Sustainable Futures. DOI: 10.1016/j.sftr.2024.100354.

All the details are provided in the Read_Me file.

In this work, a greenhouse producing tomatoes has been simulated in eight Canadian cities under current and 2080 climates based on climatic trajectory RCP8.5, in order to determine how the energy consumption and tomato yield would be affected.
dct_title_s: Model inputs and results from energy and yield greenhouse simulations under present and future climates and in eight Canadian cities
